text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#INC-3491: log-ingest.consumer.lag > 500k for >5m (eu-west-1). Auto-page to eng-sre.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: https://pagerduty.example/INC-3491 (P1)

matt (oncall): acked. I'm looking now, taking incident lead. any customer-impact notes yet?

ria: seeing consumer lag spike on the log-consumer group in eu-west-1, backlog jumping after a burst of traffic around 12:40 UTC. Grafana panels: https://grafana.redwood/logs/kafka-lag (opens)

jordan: adding context: we had a config deploy to log-consumer yesterday that changed prefetch/commit behavior. could be related. @matt wants me to try scaling consumers if you want quick mitigation.

matt (oncall): yes please. Ria, can you confirm which consumer deployment? is it `log-consumer` as usual? I can scale replicas.

ria: yep. there are 2 pods healthy, CPU ~85% on both, consumer lag > 520k. partition rebalances happening slowly.

sre-ops: temporary mitigation: increase replicas and raise max inflight to drain backlog. I recommend `replicas=6` for now. also enable consumer smoothing flag we use in emergencies.

matt (oncall): doing the scale now. running:
```
kubectl -n logging scale deployment/log-consumer --replicas=6
```

matt (oncall): scaled to 6. pods starting (crashloops none). watching lag.

ria: consumer lag dropping, from 520k -> 230k in 4 minutes. throughput increased but CPU on pods averaging 70-80.

pagerduty-bot: INC-3491 acknowledged by matt (oncall).

support-lead: support queue seeing increased error reports for webhook delivery retries for customers in eu-west-1. Not widespread yet (~12 customers reporting delays). No data loss confirmed but delays in processing.

jordan: still suspicious about the deploy change. checking git history for last config change...

jordan: found commit: `logging/consumer: set prefetch=500 -> 200` rolled 18h ago. that would reduce parallel pulls per consumer; combined with lower replica count = lower consumption capacity. we should revert or increase prefetch temporarily.

matt (oncall): good find. For now let's keep replicas up and increase prefetch via a live config bump.

sre-ops: applying config rollout (patching configmap and triggering rollout):
```
kubectl -n logging patch configmap/log-consumer-cm -p '{"data":{"PREFETCH":"500"}}'
kubectl -n logging rollout restart deployment/log-consumer
```

sre-ops: config applied and rollout started. pods are coming up with PREFETCH=500.

ria: lag now down to 45k and decreasing. rebalances completed. nice.

matt (oncall): monitoring for stability. setting a 30m watch. @support-lead please pass this to customer success: notify affected customers we saw ingestion delays but no data loss and it's resolving; we'll follow up with an RCA.

support-lead: will do. drafting message now. tentative ETA to affected customers: 30–60m for full catch-up.

pagerduty-bot: INC-3491: escalation timer suspended (acked). next on-call: jordan (in 45m) - if we need handoff I'll page.

jordan: I'll shadow for the tail end. any telemetry we should save for postmortem? I want the consumer group offsets, commit latencies, kafka broker metrics, and the deploy diff.

matt (oncall): collecting logs now. saving snapshots:
```
kafka-consumer-group --bootstrap-server kafka-eu:9092 --describe --group log-ingest > /tmp/log-ingest-group-before.txt
kubectl -n logging logs deployment/log-consumer --since=2h > /tmp/log-consumer-logs.txt
```

matt (oncall): also taking Grafana snapshots and exporting dashboard panels.

ria: can someone add the incident template to the ticket? I'll paste the key metrics.

sre-ops: adding note: root cause likely config regression + low replica count; immediate mitigation: scale + revert prefetch. Next actions: schedule controlled revert in non-peak, add a deploy-time gating check for consumer throughput impact, add alert tuning to avoid immediate P1 for transient bursts.

matt (oncall): agree. I'll keep INC-3491 open until lag is stable under 5k for 20m. if that holds we'll resolve and follow up with an RCA.

support-lead: update sent to customer success and support. message: "We've observed delayed log ingestion for a subset of customers in eu-west-1; backlog is actively being drained and full catch-up is expected within 1 hour. No logs have been lost. We'll follow up with details and root cause once investigated." :white_check_mark:

jordan: lag is steady ~3.8k and decreasing. looks good.

matt (oncall): closing watch in 10m. prepping post-incident notes.

matt (oncall): marking INC-3491 resolved (auto-resolution after 20m stable). Will open a follow-up ticket for RCA and change to deploy gating.

incident-bot: INC-3491 resolved by matt (oncall). Thanks team. :party-parrot:

sre-ops: follow-up items captured: 1) Revert deploy test to ensure PREFETCH defaults, 2) Add a pre-deploy perf smoke test that checks consumer throughput vs baseline, 3) Adjust alert threshold so small transient spikes don't P1, 4) Runbook update to include quick scale commands and configmap keys.

jordan: assigning RCA to ria + matt. I'll co-author.

support-lead: I'll send a post-incident customer note after RCA is ready.

matt (oncall): nice work everyone. handoff to jordan in 30m if anything else pops. otherwise normal ops.

ria: thx. good run. :thumbsup:
